mechanism_claims.claim_text: Kn2-7 anti-HIV-1 activity is supported as direct interaction/targeting of HIV-1 pseudotyped viral particles rather than pretreating cells after infection.

mechanism_claims.limitations: The source supports viral-particle interaction and envelope-associated binding context, not a mapped molecular epitope or pore mechanism.
